capabilities: Collect notes, PDFs, images, audio, and video on whiteboards
Build brain boards with parent/child branches and bidirectional associations
Draw and edit ink strokes and export them as SVG
Arrange cards, groups, and chapters and generate a separate Markdown draft
Resume named reading positions across board occurrences
disambiguation: Not a simple drawing whiteboard; boards hold linked note cards, mind maps, handwriting, media, and a writing workspace.
extras: Physical mobile devices, Pencil, and palm rejection are untested per the README; most interfaces besides settings are Chinese only; a separate Node 22 CLI can validate and create board files but adds no AI service.
problem: Obsidian has no single workspace that combines material collection, mind-map idea linking, handwriting, and draft writing while keeping everything as vault files.
summary: Visual research workspace that collects notes and media on boards, links ideas in mind maps, and arranges cards into a generated Markdown draft.
